name: Philippines (PAGCOR) Market Profile - domestic-facing only

bindingStandards.name: PAGCOR licensing framework for domestic e-games / e-casino / live dealer
bindingStandards.notes: Domestic-facing online gaming is lawful under a PAGCOR licence. OFFSHORE-FACING operations (POGO / IGL) have been PROHIBITED since 2024-12-31 under EO 74.

maxStakePerSpin.notes: A Senate bill proposing a minimum bet of PHP 10,000 and minimum top-up of PHP 5,000 is NOT ENACTED. Note it would be a MINIMUM, not a maximum - an affordability measure that would exclude low-stake play.

otherProhibitions.item: All gambling billboards and out-of-home advertising removed by 2025-08-15; Ads Standards Council pre-approval MOA required

minimum.notes: This figure is for LAND-BASED EGMs. NO ONLINE-SLOT-SPECIFIC RTP FIGURE WAS FOUND - do not assume the 90% carries over to online without confirmation.

minimumAge.notes: Raised to 21 in 2025. Do not assume 18 for this market.

requirement.value: The remote gaming platform must be PAGCOR-approved and ACCESSIBLE ONLY FROM WITHIN THE PHILIPPINES
requirement.notes: This is a geo-restriction requirement rather than a confirmed server-location mandate. An explicit server-in-country rule is UNVERIFIED.

localEntityRequirement.value: All B2B parties - content, aggregation, payments, marketing and testing laboratories - require local PAGCOR accreditation under the framework effective 2025-10-02
localEntityRequirement.notes: A game supplier cannot rely on the operator's licence alone; it needs its own accreditation.

certification.labModel: Test report from a PAGCOR-accredited Independent Gaming Testing Laboratory (ITL)
certification.notes: PAGCOR's published accredited-lab list names Eclipse Compliance Testing and GLI Australia. GLI was announced as the first accredited iGAMING ITL on 2026-03-23, with a B2B deadline of 2026-03-31. The full current list of accredited iGaming ITLs is UNVERIFIED.

consultantNotes: The single most important point: the Philippines is now a DOMESTIC-FACING market only. The offshore (POGO) model is prohibited. Any client whose plan is 'get a Philippine licence to serve players elsewhere' is describing a model that no longer exists.
The 90% figure circulating for the Philippines is a land-based EGM requirement. Do not apply it to an online product without confirmation.
Minimum age is 21, and B2B suppliers need their own PAGCOR accreditation. Both are commonly missed.
